acceptanceCriteria.text: Planning guidance requires a Source locations section and structured file references for implementation cards and tickets.
All three delivery-standards mirrors remain byte-identical and verification evidence is recorded.

body:
## Source locations
- `skills/planner.md`: Kanban cards and per-ticket requirements now mandate a Source locations section and structured references.
- `.agents/skills/delivery-standards/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/delivery-standards/SKILL.md`, `.cursor/skills/delivery-standards/SKILL.md`: identical standing ticket-content rule covering verified paths, symbols, placement and regression tests.

Persist the requested planning convention in skills/planner.md and all three delivery-standards SKILL.md mirrors: every implementation card/ticket names verified repository paths, relevant symbols, test locations and intended placement of new files, with structured file references. Unknown causes remain explicit investigation, never invented paths. Documentation-only; no new unit tests (no runtime behavior changes). Verify identical delivery mirrors and run applicable repository gates. This card tracks the user-requested guidance update, not execution of DM-502.

## Verification evidence
All three delivery mirrors have identical SHA-256: 959a3c6474362463b42351d7e9c4e0340a2ed5b290195c334f1e15daf5215cb8. Documentation-only; no runtime behavior or unit tests changed, so Fireguard is not applicable. The initial npm shell launcher failed before checks started; Windows npm.cmd is used instead. Lint, deadcode and build passed. App tests: 10,310 passed, 56 skipped, 3 failed with EPERM creating Windows file symlinks (conflictsOpen.test.ts and handlersWorkingDiff.test.ts). Fireguard own suite: 164 passed, 1 failed with the same EPERM in snapshots.test.ts. No test assertions or permission checks were weakened. Typecheck passed; full delivery gate is blocked by missing file-symlink rights. The guidance edits are applied but not accepted or marked complete. DM-502 revision 2 now includes seven structured source references and explicit implementation/investigation locations.
title: Require verified source locations in future cards and tickets
